convergence.reason: The blocking set did not strictly shrink for a second consecutive candidate and both reviewers found new blocking classes. This is a literal convergence-rule trigger.

high.evidence: The reviewed candidate is a 40-hex Git object, but the runner applies its 64-hex artifact validator to candidate_hash; the real candidate is rejected before preflight while synthetic tests use 64 hex characters.
high.reproduction_instructions: Invoke the runner with the exact reviewed Git commit and otherwise syntactically valid arguments; argparse rejects candidate_hash.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Use a distinct Git-object validator, bind the exact executing clean HEAD, and test the real reviewed commit.

high.evidence: The scorer accepts synthetic manifest/row objects with no receipt, runtime maps, server logs, completion bodies, systemd records, descriptor snapshots, or timestamped memory evidence. It does not reconstruct rows from a terminal artifact inventory.
high.affected_gate: Terminal evidence authority and anti-cheating validity
high.reproduction_instructions: Run the positive synthetic scorer fixture without any per-arm artifacts; it returns PASS. Trigger early failure and observe an incomplete evidence triplet.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Validate a complete attempt directory, independently rebuild every row from hash-bound artifacts, rerun BLS/scoring, and reject every mutation or omission.

high.evidence: The runner expects unauthenticated /health to return 401 or 403, but the exact server declares /health public, so every honest arm would fail.
high.reproduction_instructions: Inspect the exact server public-route set or request /health without Authorization.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Use public health only for readiness and probe unauthenticated rejection on protected /completion.

high.evidence: The runner has no SIGTERM/SIGINT cleanup handler; _unit_stop ignores stop errors and treats an unqueryable unit as stopped. A failed-path arm can leave a contained process alive without a survivor verdict.
high.reproduction_instructions: Make stop and subsequent show fail; _unit_stop returns without proving PID, cgroup, or listener absence.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Retain active identity in signal handlers, fail closed on control errors, and prove cgroup/PID/listener emptiness on every exit.

high.evidence: BLS is verified, but any authentic round above a stale hardcoded floor is accepted. Unsigned local fields can relabel a pre-final-freeze round with the final candidate.
high.reproduction_instructions: Attach the candidate field to an authentic round above the floor but older than the final commit; no final-freeze timestamp check rejects it.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: After final freeze, bind a fresh three-relay receipt and verify authenticated publication time after the exact commit/freeze time.

medium.evidence: Source markers exist, but no test injects uploader device, capability, allocation, event, or initialization failures.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Inspect committed mutations; they cover only direct open/read failures.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Inject every uploader setup failure and prove cleanup and the aggregate staging cap.

medium.evidence: Continuous memory sampling stops after load, leaving completion, closure hashing, status capture, and teardown gaps; only a scalar minimum is preserved.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Inject a transient post-load floor violation; no timestamped series records it.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Run and bind an external timestamped sampler until the cgroup is empty and reject coverage gaps.

high.evidence: Runner and scorer accept caller-selected self-consistent identities; consistently replacing candidate, binary, and runtime-bundle identities still scores PASS.
high.reproduction_instructions: Replace all matching manifest and row identities in the positive fixture and rescore.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Bind both runner and scorer to a separately frozen exact authority and reject every consistent substitution.

high.evidence: Uploader failures remain untested, and the host-buffer tensor branch can reach a tensor-sized aligned temporary outside the 269000000-byte bound.
high.reproduction_instructions: Follow the host-buffer file read into read_aligned_chunk and inspect absent uploader fault hooks.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Fault every uploader setup exit and exercise a larger-than-cap host tensor under allocation accounting.

high.evidence: Stop/query failures can return as clean and survivor checks occur only on success.
high.reproduction_instructions: Raise after start, fail stop/show, and retain a member or listener.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Require identity-bound kill/reap plus cgroup, PID, process, and listener absence on every path.

high.evidence: Post-load blocking requests and teardown are outside continuous sampling, and terminal status is not recaptured.
high.reproduction_instructions: Place transient memory or terminal safety events in current blind windows.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Sample continuously through teardown and preserve/recompute timestamped safety evidence.

medium.evidence: Preflight failures precede attempt creation, and created attempts lack a terminal artifact inventory.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Fail initial preflight or inspect the manifest schema.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Create the attempt before preflight and finalize a hash-closed receipt on every exit.

medium.evidence: Fault confirmation omits exact environment and mapped dependency closure; the probe still has a temporary-build RUNPATH.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Compare readelf and ldd resolution to the recorded confirmation.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Re-run from an empty allowlisted environment against the frozen bundle and bind argv, environment, mapped closure, and outputs.
